sample_unit: AI-generated patient education guides (3 topics x 2 models)

links.outcome: Readability (ease score, grade level) of AI-generated cardiac patient education guides
links.effect: No significant difference in ease score (p = 0.7244) between models; ChatGPT tended to produce more complex content on some topics; Gemini generally easier to read.
links.quote: ChatGPT tended to produce more complex content for certain topics, whereas Google Gemini's responses were generally easier to read.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the readability and quality (via DISCERN) of patient education materials generated by ChatGPT and Google Gemini for cardiac health topics.
